value.body: After a B.Stat or B.Math from ISI, or a B.Sc from CMI, most students consider a master's. CMI offers M.Sc programmes in Mathematics, Computer Science and Data Science; ISI offers M.Stat, M.Math and other master's programmes; IITs and IISc admit through JAM; and some students apply for integrated PhD programmes or study abroad.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: CMI M.Sc: CMI's national entrance test, usually in May, with interviews for some streams. ISI M.Stat / M.Math: ISI's admission test; ISI's own B.Stat / B.Math graduates may be eligible for direct admission under its rules. IITs and IISc: IIT JAM. Elsewhere: CUET-PG or university tests.

value.title: At a glance
items: You are not tied to your undergraduate institute; ISI, CMI, IITs, IISc and TIFR each run their own admissions.
At CMI, the Data Science M.Sc costs more than the Mathematics and CS programmes, and hostel space is not guaranteed for it.
Outcomes include PhDs in India or abroad, quantitative finance, data science and research roles.
